question: Fausto Coppi broke cycling's Hour Record in wartime Milan on Nov. 7, 1942, 84 years ago this weekend. How far past Maurice Archambaud's 1937 mark did he ride?
question_short: Coppi broke cycling's Hour Record in 1942. How far past the old record did he ride?
answer_detail: Coppi rode 45.798 km to Archambaud's 45.767 km on the same Milan track. His razor-thin record still stood for nearly 14 years, until Jacques Anquetil broke it in 1956.
answer_short: Coppi rode 45.798 km, just 31 m past Archambaud, and held the record nearly 14 years.
